title: Golden Wheel FQA
subtitle: Single-Needle Direct-Drive Lockstitch Machine (FQA Series)

purposeAndApplication.purpose: The Golden Wheel FQA is a single-needle direct-drive lockstitch machine. The FQA identifier designates the single-needle direct-drive sub-family within Golden Wheel's broader lockstitch lineup; specific numeric variants (FQA-9000 series) are catalog-internal references not surfaced on the global public homepage.
applications: General straight-stitch seaming on woven fabrics
Garment assembly requiring direct-drive energy savings
Light-to-medium material work in apparel production
purposeAndApplication.industry: Garment manufacturing, light industrial textile assembly

overviewDescription: Made by Golden Wheel / Chee Siang Industrial Co., Ltd. (Taiwan). FQA is a sub-family within Golden Wheel's lockstitch lineup; the bare 'FQA' (without numeric suffix) appears as a category heading on the manufacturer's catalog structure. Specific FQA sub-variant numbers (e.g., FQA-9000) appear in Chinese-market distribution but were not surfaced in Tier-1 documentation during the Phase 1 Basic Research session.

finalNotes: Phase 1 PARTIAL PASS — brand (Golden Wheel / Chee Siang, Taiwan) verified Tier-1. FQA series verified as a category in Golden Wheel's catalog structure. No Tier-1 or Tier-2 source located with numeric specifications for the bare 'FQA' identifier — Golden Wheel's public homepage and YouTube reference list other series (CS, CSA, CSN, CSU) in detail, with FQA only as a category heading.
